name: ATXP
description: Give AI agents a funded account with a wallet, an email address and pay-per-call tools for search, crawling and media, plus an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway, for agent builders.

skills.name: Register Account
skills.description: Registers a funded ATXP account with credits, an Ethereum wallet and an email address from a single CLI command.

skills.name: Call LLM Gateway
skills.description: Calls Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama and other models through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint billed to the ATXP account.

skills.name: Pay-per-call Tools
skills.description: Calls paid MCP tools for web search, crawling, image, music and video generation and code execution, paying per call.

skills.name: Agent Email
skills.description: Sends and receives email at the agent's own atxp.email address through ATXP's pay-per-call email tool.

skills.name: Monetize MCP Server
skills.description: Charges per tool call from your own MCP server with ATXP's server SDK, so other agents pay to use your tools.
